headline: KHR glTF splat、SPZ、SOG、8K export を format pressure として統合する
headlineEn: Unify KHR glTF splats, SPZ, SOG, and 8K export as format pressure
summary: 2026-07-26 は、PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.0/v2.21.1 の KHR_gaussian_splatting と SPZ 対応、SuperSplat v2.32.2 の 8K render resolution と video muxer finalize 修正、Babylon.js 9.18.0 の Gaussian Splat resize leak 修正、three.js r185 の HTMLTexture / HTML-in-Canvas 更新を、splat 表現の runtime 診断と export pressure として整理しました。追加ミニ試作は単体 WebGL の glTF Splat Format Pressure Scope です。
summaryEn: For 2026-07-26, PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.0/v2.21.1 KHR_gaussian_splatting and SPZ support, SuperSplat v2.32.2 8K render resolution and video muxer finalization fixes, Babylon.js 9.18.0 Gaussian Splat resize leak fixes, and three.js r185 HTMLTexture / HTML-in-Canvas updates are framed as runtime diagnostics and export pressure for splat expression. The added mini prototype is a standalone WebGL glTF Splat Format Pressure Scope.

links.label: SIGGRAPH Gaussian Splatting virtual production article

sections.title: 今日の重要トピック
sections.body: 1. PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.0 は 2026-07-21 に KHR_gaussian_splatting glTF extension と SPZ gaussian splat format support を追加し、GSplat script class naming も整理しました。7/23 まで追っていた SOG/SPZ format pressure が、glTF 標準寄りの interchange と直結しました。2. PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.1 は 2026-07-24 に MSDF coverage ramp の小サイズ問題、WebGPU derivative TBN normal mapping、WebGPU sampled texture limit 報告を修正しました。小さい注釈や postprocess 後の文字の破綻を診断対象にできます。3. SuperSplat v2.32.2 は 2026-07-21 に 8K render resolutions と video muxer writes 待ちを追加/修正しました。高解像度 export は表現品質だけでなく、メモリ、resize、finalize の pressure を可視化する対象です。4. Babylon.js 9.18.0 は 2026-07-23 に Gaussian Splat texture leak with resize を修正しました。長時間鑑賞、画面回転、capture 解像度切替を含む体験では、resize が表現上のイベントにも診断上のイベントにもなります。5. three.js r185 の HTMLTexture / HTML-in-Canvas API signature 対応は、MSDF だけでは足りない豊かな HTML 注釈を shader surface として扱う流れの継続案件です。
sections.bodyEn: 1. PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.0, released on 2026-07-21, added KHR_gaussian_splatting glTF extension support and SPZ Gaussian splat format support, while also cleaning up GSplat script class naming. The SOG/SPZ format-pressure track from 07-23 now connects directly to standards-oriented interchange. 2. PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.1, released on 2026-07-24, fixes small-size MSDF coverage ramp behavior, WebGPU derivative TBN normal mapping, and reported WebGPU sampled texture limits. This makes tiny annotations and postprocessed text stability a diagnostic topic. 3. SuperSplat v2.32.2, released on 2026-07-21, adds 8K render resolutions and waits for video muxer writes before finalizing. High-resolution export is not only a quality feature; it is pressure on memory, resize handling, and finalization. 4. Babylon.js 9.18.0, released on 2026-07-23, fixes a Gaussian Splat texture leak on resize. Long viewing sessions, rotation, and capture-resolution changes make resize both an expressive event and a diagnostic event. 5. three.js r185 HTMLTexture / HTML-in-Canvas API signature support keeps the path open for richer HTML annotation surfaces beyond MSDF labels.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable examples and why they matter
sections.body: 注目事例は、PlayCanvas の splat formats docs と SuperSplat v2.32.x の export 強化を、SIGGRAPH の Gaussian Splatting virtual production 事例、ULTRA の single-pass GLSL surface 群と並べて見ることです。PlayCanvas docs は PLY、SOG、Streamed SOG、GLB、SPZ を用途、サイズ、品質、速度で切り分けています。これは単なる保存形式表ではなく、作品内で『どの部分が即時表示で、どこが標準 interchange で、どこが高精細 export 待ちか』を可視化する設計語彙になります。SIGGRAPH の事例は splat を撮影・演出の空間として使う方向、ULTRA は画像なし単体 shader surface を触れる光として成立させる方向で、両者を組み合わせると、splat scene の format/loading/export 状態そのものを触れる照明・粒子・ラベルとして表現できます。
sections.bodyEn: The notable connection is to read PlayCanvas splat format docs and SuperSplat v2.32.x export improvements alongside the SIGGRAPH Gaussian Splatting virtual production case and ULTRA's single-pass GLSL surfaces. PlayCanvas separates PLY, SOG, Streamed SOG, GLB, and SPZ by use case, size, quality, and speed. That is more than a file-format table; it becomes a visual vocabulary for showing which parts of a work are immediate runtime delivery, which are standards interchange, and which are waiting on high-resolution export. The SIGGRAPH case treats splats as production space, while ULTRA treats shader surfaces as touchable light. Together they suggest making format/loading/export state itself visible as lighting, particles, and labels inside the splat scene.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 今日の中心案は「format pressure を見せる splat scope」です。画面を GLB/KHR、SOG stream、SPZ compressed、HTML/MSDF labels の 4 レーンに分け、ポインタを inspection lens、長押しを relighting coverage、F を fisheye stress、Space を 8K/export pressure pulse にします。GLB/KHR レーンは標準 interchange と AA mismatch、SOG レーンは chunk stream risk、SPZ レーンは圧縮で細部が軽くなるが export には強い状態、HTML/MSDF レーンは小さい文字の coverage ramp と HTMLTexture 注釈面として読む。短期では疑似データの shader 表現で十分です。中長期では PlayCanvas の actual format / currentRenderer / chunk load / relighting coverage alpha / export queue を uniform または texture に流し込みます。
sections.bodyEn: Today's core idea is a splat scope that visualizes format pressure. Split the screen into four lanes: GLB/KHR, SOG stream, SPZ compressed, and HTML/MSDF labels. Pointer acts as an inspection lens, holding reveals relighting coverage, F toggles fisheye stress, and Space triggers an 8K/export pressure pulse. The GLB/KHR lane reads as standards interchange plus AA mismatch; SOG reads as chunk-stream risk; SPZ reads as compressed detail tradeoff with strong delivery; HTML/MSDF reads as tiny text coverage ramp and HTMLTexture annotation surfaces. Short term, pseudo data in a shader is enough. Mid/long term, feed actual PlayCanvas format, currentRenderer, chunk load, relighting coverage alpha, and export queue into uniforms or a texture.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: PlayCanvas v2.21.0 の KHR_gaussian_splatting と SPZ 対応により、runtime loader は format ごとの分岐を隠しやすくなりますが、表現側ではむしろ format を消さないほうが面白いです。GLB は標準化・他ツール連携、SOG は runtime delivery、Streamed SOG は超大規模 scene の視線依存、SPZ は mobile/share という役割を shader channel にできます。MSDF coverage ramp 修正は label の最小サイズ検証に効きます。Babylon の resize leak 修正は DPR 変更、orientation 変更、8K capture の stress test とセットで見るべきです。three.js HTMLTexture は canvas 内に HTML 由来の注釈を入れ、fragment shader で distortion / occlusion / relighting と混ぜる候補です。
sections.bodyEn: PlayCanvas v2.21.0 KHR_gaussian_splatting and SPZ support make it easier for runtime loaders to hide format-specific branches, but expression-wise it may be better not to hide format. GLB can mean standardization and tool interchange; SOG can mean runtime delivery; Streamed SOG can mean view-dependent very-large-scene loading; SPZ can mean mobile/share-friendly compression. The MSDF coverage-ramp fix matters for minimum label-size tests. Babylon's resize leak fix should be tested with DPR changes, orientation changes, and 8K capture. three.js HTMLTexture is a candidate for HTML-derived annotations that can be distorted, occluded, and relit in fragment shaders.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 継続案件: PlayCanvas Engine 2.21.x の KHR_gaussian_splatting / SPZ / GSplat renderer、SuperSplat 2.32.x の 8K export と orient/grid tool、Babylon.js 9.18.0 以降の Gaussian Splat resize 安定化、three.js HTMLTexture。新規案件: KHR_gaussian_splatting の AA filter 議論、PlayCanvas splat-transform の GLB/SOG/SPZ 変換経路、ULTRA 的な single-pass shader surface を splat 診断に重ねる方向。寝かせる案件: カード UI、重い editor 全体、training pipeline、XR 専用操作。短期は疑似 format pressure scope、中長期は実 loader/export telemetry の shader texture 化です。
sections.bodyEn: Continue watching: PlayCanvas Engine 2.21.x KHR_gaussian_splatting / SPZ / GSplat renderer, SuperSplat 2.32.x 8K export plus orient/grid tooling, Babylon.js 9.18.0 and later Gaussian Splat resize stability, and three.js HTMLTexture. New: KHR_gaussian_splatting AA-filter discussion, PlayCanvas splat-transform GLB/SOG/SPZ conversion routes, and applying ULTRA-like single-pass shader surfaces over splat diagnostics. Park: card UI, full heavy editors, training pipelines, and XR-specific controls. Short term is the pseudo format-pressure scope; mid/long term is turning real loader/export telemetry into shader textures.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: 今日試すなら、format の違いを UI 表ではなく shader の圧力場として表示することです。作成した `outputs/2026-07-26_gltf_splat_format_pressure_scope.html` は、GLB/KHR、SOG、SPZ、HTML/MSDF の 4 レーンを持ち、pointer lens、hold relight coverage、F fisheye stress、Space 8K/export pressure pulse で状態を変えます。次に足すなら、PlayCanvas の scene asset metadata から format を取り、chunk stream / renderer / relighting / export queue を RGBA の小さな state texture として渡します。
sections.bodyEn: If trying one thing today, show format differences as a shader pressure field rather than a UI table. The created `outputs/2026-07-26_gltf_splat_format_pressure_scope.html` has four lanes for GLB/KHR, SOG, SPZ, and HTML/MSDF, with pointer lens, hold relight coverage, F fisheye stress, and Space 8K/export pressure pulse. Next, pull format from PlayCanvas scene asset metadata and pass chunk stream, renderer, relighting, and export queue state as a compact RGBA state texture.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: ネタ収集: PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.0/v2.21.1、SuperSplat v2.32.2、Babylon.js 9.18.0、three.js r185、KHR_gaussian_splatting、PlayCanvas splat formats、SIGGRAPH Gaussian Splatting production 事例、ULTRA を確認。アイデア検討: 7/23 の format pressure、7/25 の relighting/fisheye/MSDF/flashlight を、glTF/SPZ/SOG/export の 4 レーン診断へ接続。サンプル実装: 単体 WebGL で format pressure scope を追加済み。結果の検証: upsert-report --publish 後に day page と sample の HTTP 到達を確認する。短期で試せるものは疑似 format channel。中長期で育てるものは実 asset format、renderer state、relighting coverage、export queue を統合した performance instrument です。
sections.bodyEn: Collection: checked PlayCanvas Engine v2.21.0/v2.21.1, SuperSplat v2.32.2, Babylon.js 9.18.0, three.js r185, KHR_gaussian_splatting, PlayCanvas splat formats, the SIGGRAPH Gaussian Splatting production case, and ULTRA. Ideation: connected 07-23 format pressure and 07-25 relighting/fisheye/MSDF/flashlight into a four-lane glTF/SPZ/SOG/export diagnostic. Prototype: added a standalone WebGL format-pressure scope. Verification: after upsert-report --publish, confirm HTTP access for the day page and sample. Short term, use pseudo format channels. Mid/long term, grow a performance instrument that combines real asset format, renderer state, relighting coverage, and export queue.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 最近の傾向は、Gaussian Splat が『見た目の新奇性』から『交換・圧縮・streaming・export・照明の状態をどう扱うか』へ移っていることです。7/17-7/23 は retry budget、upload gesture、export resolution、format pressure。7/25 は relighting / fisheye / flashlight。今日 7/26 はそれを glTF/SPZ/SOG/HTML label の互換性と出力圧力へ広げました。組み合わせる価値が高いテーマは、format state を隠すローダーではなく、format state を触れる光・粒子・ラベルに変えること。育てる価値が高いのは、作品にも検証にも使える shader diagnostic layer です。
sections.bodyEn: The recent trend is that Gaussian Splatting is moving from visual novelty to handling interchange, compression, streaming, export, and lighting state. 07-17 to 07-23 covered retry budget, upload gesture, export resolution, and format pressure. 07-25 covered relighting / fisheye / flashlight. Today, 07-26 expands that into glTF/SPZ/SOG/HTML-label compatibility and output pressure. The high-value combination is not a loader that hides format state, but an expressive layer that turns format state into touchable light, particles, and labels. The theme worth growing is a shader diagnostic layer useful both as artwork and as verification tooling.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した試作は「glTF Splat Format Pressure Scope」です。作成済みファイルは `outputs/2026-07-26_gltf_splat_format_pressure_scope.html`。実際に動く内容は、raw WebGL fragment shader による疑似 splat field、4 レーンの format state、pointer inspection lens、長押し relighting coverage、F による fisheye stress、Space/resize による 8K/export pressure pulse、小さい pseudo label の MSDF coverage 観察です。次の発展順は、1. PlayCanvas asset metadata から format lane を自動選択、2. SOG chunk load state を stream risk に接続、3. relighting.texture alpha を coverage に接続、4. export/capture queue と resize event を pressure pulse に接続、です。
sections.bodyEn: The selected prototype is glTF Splat Format Pressure Scope. The created file is `outputs/2026-07-26_gltf_splat_format_pressure_scope.html`. It runs as a raw WebGL fragment shader with a pseudo splat field, four lanes of format state, pointer inspection lens, hold-to-show relighting coverage, F-driven fisheye stress, Space/resize-driven 8K/export pressure pulse, and tiny pseudo labels for MSDF coverage observation. The next development order is: 1. auto-select format lanes from PlayCanvas asset metadata, 2. connect SOG chunk load state to stream risk, 3. connect relighting.texture alpha to coverage, and 4. connect export/capture queue plus resize events to pressure pulses.
